def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Find maximal axis-aligned monochrome rectangles. Only recolor a
    # rectangle when both dimensions are at least five cells.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            for bottom in range(r + 4, h):
                for right in range(c + 4, w):
                    if (all(grid[y][x] == color
                            for y in range(r, bottom + 1)
                            for x in range(c, right + 1))):
                        # Require maximality: it cannot be extended by a row
                        # or column of the same color.
                        if (r > 0 and all(grid[r - 1][x] == color
                                          for x in range(c, right + 1))):
                            continue
                        if (c > 0 and all(grid[y][c - 1] == color
                                          for y in range(r, bottom + 1))):
                            continue
                        if (bottom + 1 < h and all(grid[bottom + 1][x] == color
                                                   for x in range(c, right + 1))):
                            continue
                        if (right + 1 < w and all(grid[y][right + 1] == color
                                                  for y in range(r, bottom + 1))):
                            continue
                        for y in range(r, bottom + 1):
                            for x in range(c, right + 1):
                                out[y][x] = 4
    return out

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Find maximal solid monochrome rectangles, recoloring those at least 5x5.
    # For each top row and left edge, extend downward while tracking the
    # common same-color width available across every row.
    for top in range(h):
        for left in range(w):
            color = grid[top][left]
            common = w - left
            for bottom in range(top, h):
                run = 0
                while left + run < w and grid[bottom][left + run] == color:
                    run += 1
                common = min(common, run)
                height = bottom - top + 1
                if height < 5 or common < 5:
                    continue

                right = left + common - 1
                # Only accept rectangles that cannot be extended by a full
                # adjacent row or column of the same color.
                if top > 0 and all(grid[top - 1][x] == color
                                   for x in range(left, right + 1)):
                    continue
                if bottom + 1 < h and all(grid[bottom + 1][x] == color
                                          for x in range(left, right + 1)):
                    continue

                                    for y in range(top, bottom + 1)):
                    continue
                if right + 1 < w and all(grid[y][right + 1] == color
                                         for y in range(top, bottom + 1)):
                    continue

                for y in range(top, bottom + 1):
